Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (January 11, 2024) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Quotation, Doc4065677598 Description: For the non-exclusive supply and delivery of Flags to various Purchasing and Materials Management (Stores) locations from the date of award to January 31, 2025, with the option to renew the Contract for four (4) additional one (1)-year periods at the sole discretion of the City and subject to budget approval(s).
